statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of five public templates/states. Video/live studio, authenticated account management, and purchase submission were not exercised because they are separate high-risk journeys or require credentials; relevant static controls and policies were inspected.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-page publication (no client framework detected)
page.notes: Norwegian news publication with homepage, section listing, article, subscription, and branded 404 templates.

paths.description: Homepage and first-visit consent state; represents the main discovery surface.
Nyheter section listing; represents category/index templates and route discovery.
Current news article reached from the homepage; represents the core reading journey and rich metadata.
Dagbladet Pluss purchase surface; represents the commercial/account flow without submitting a transaction.
Intentionally invalid route; represents HTTP failure and recovery handling.

findings.summary: Dark mode preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains a light page and the root computed colorScheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and retint surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion users still receive continuous animation
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found 12 running animations lasting 6–18 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove non-essential pulsation/background animation and stop auto-motion.

findings.summary: News navigation swaps documents abruptly
findings.evidence: No View Transition styling or signal appeared across the homepage, listing, and article probes.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state-aware navigation cue
findings.evidence: The long article/home templates show unchanged masthead chrome and no scroll-state/container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll-state queries or a lightweight reading-progress/shrinking-header affordance that preserves access to navigation.

findings.summary: Consent wall obscures all news content on first load
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360px screenshots show a blocking modal; on mobile it occupies nearly the full viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the blocking first-load wall with a less intrusive consent treatment where legally possible, preserving equal accept/reject choices and immediate content access.

findings.summary: Consent modal uses a custom DIV dialog
findings.evidence: The DOM reports DIV role=dialog aria-modal=true rather than a native dialog element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native <dialog> with showModal(), focus return, Escape/platform dismissal where policy permits, and semantic controls.

findings.summary: Reusable cards do not use container-level adaptation
findings.evidence: All representative template probes found zero @container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Define component containment and use @container for card typography/layout where cards appear in different columns.

findings.summary: Largest content appears after roughly seven seconds
findings.evidence: Lighthouse LCP was 7.7s and trace LCP 6.92s; FCP was 6.3s in Lighthouse.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the actual LCP image, avoid lazy-loading it, add fetchpriority=high/preload when discoverability requires it, and reduce pre-content work.

findings.summary: The critical network path is heavy and fragmented
findings.evidence: HAR captured 118 requests/4.73MB, ten high-priority parser-inserted stylesheet candidates, and several hero images taking over 3s.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or consolidate truly critical CSS, defer non-critical styles, and make LCP assets discoverable early with correct priority.

findings.summary: Third-party scripting imposes a large startup cost
findings.evidence: The page loaded 33 scripts/1.12MB and 43 third-party requests/1.40MB, including ad-tech libraries.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory script value, remove duplicates/unneeded vendors, and conditionally load ad/video dependencies after consent or user intent.

findings.summary: A headline kicker fails text contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.43:1 for red #d60000 text on yellow #f1ca3f at 16px, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose a darker red or different background that reaches at least 4.5:1 while preserving the editorial treatment.

findings.summary: Page-level heading structure is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Homepage/listing contain no H1, while the article includes a second unrelated H1 in recommendations.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each template one descriptive page H1 and keep recommendation headings subordinate.

findings.summary: A paywall integration throws on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured ReferenceError: kilkaya is not defined at the homepage paywall integration.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard optional vendor globals, sequence dependency loading, and handle vendor failure without console exceptions.

findings.summary: Image markup wastes bytes and risks instability
findings.evidence: Image inspection found 7 missing dimensions, 26 oversized images, and 94/100 without srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height, responsive srcset/sizes, and right-sized modern variants for each card slot.

findings.summary: The homepage cannot use the back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three BFCache blockers, including cache-control:no-store on the main resource.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit no-store usage and cookie mutation; use private/no-cache with revalidation where confidentiality permits so back navigation can restore instantly.

findings.summary: Baseline transport defenses and cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: Headers had no CSP or HSTS; five cookies lacked Secure, including long-lived identifiers.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS and a nonce/hash-based CSP, then mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest viable SameSite and HttpOnly posture.

findings.summary: Tracking starts with a broad third-party footprint
findings.evidence: The first load contacted 20 third-party origins, including DoubleClick/Rubicon; 43 requests transferred 1.40MB before a consent choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential vendors until an affirmative choice, reduce vendor count, batch analytics, and document a data-minimised purpose for each endpoint.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive headers are absent
findings.evidence: No CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy was returned.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, HSTS, nosniff, a strict referrer policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Consent choices have unequal visual prominence
findings.evidence: “Godta alle” is saturated blue while “Tilpass eller avvis” is muted grey in every fresh-load mobile dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Give accept and reject/manage choices equal visual weight, direct wording, and comparable interaction cost.

findings.summary: Responsive image delivery is under-optimised
findings.evidence: 26 images are oversized, 94/100 lack srcset, and 28 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate slot-sized AVIF/WebP variants, use srcset/sizes, and lazy-load non-LCP below-fold imagery.

findings.summary: Substantial non-content work begins before user intent
findings.evidence: A fresh load makes 118 requests, including advertising/video dependencies and 43 third-party calls.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritise or conditionally import background/ad/video work after consent, visibility, or explicit interaction.

findings.summary: Third-party and media budgets are disproportionate to first-view news reading
findings.evidence: The 4.73MB load includes 1.40MB third-party bytes, 683KB media, and 1.12MB scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set template budgets, defer media, self-host/subset fonts where useful, and remove vendors that do not justify their transfer and runtime cost.

taskList.title: Gate and reduce third-party tracking and background work
Deploy complete defensive security headers and secure cookie flags
Make consent non-obstructive and visually neutral
Fix LCP discovery and critical resource delivery
Repair contrast and page heading structure
Use a native semantic consent dialog
Remove the paywall console exception and BFCache blockers
Progressively enhance document navigation with View Transitions
